parameter_provenance: Explicit user instruction: Proceed on to stage 4 retaining the value of EA as 40
scientific_selection: None; Stage 03.1 retained all five candidates. EA40 is a user-fixed development hypothesis, not a validated winner.
baseline: B0 is the saved experiments/m0_baseline_reference/result.csv; additionally reconstruct original W1 M0 on identical eligible rows and verify equivalence, without replacing B0.
primary_export: result.csv: EA40, one-day bounded hold, reference_gap assumption; experimental full-horizon candidate only
observed_only_export: Incomplete-history descriptor, not a physical full-history forecast
eligibility: RepositoryData checksum contract, build_training_windows once, eligible_training per target; labels strictly earlier than target cutoff, cold-start target entire parent excluded. History QA at each window's own cutoff. Keep negative measured loss; exclude missing between-VTD baselines exactly as existing API.
fit: r=max(0,sum(W1*E*(h0-h_obs))/sum(W1*E^2)); denominator must be positive and all fitting sums finite. Separate rate per case/candidate/hold/policy. Fit objective before thickness clipping. No temperature double counting.
prediction: clip(h0-r*E,0,h0); zero observed exposure retained with missingness and descriptor warning; all-zero fit denominator is unavailable, no silent fallback
intervals: Use Stage 02 T-only API; freeze once per section/start/cutoff/hold, reuse across all candidates. No W/v requirement, interpolation, backward fill, spatial or 20C/4C temperature substitutions.
evaluation: Audit strict forward-time held-parent folds; fit only permissible earlier training if available. Within-parent section diagnostics are not independent validation. Production targets have no evaluation labels or metrics. Report fit diagnostics and sensitivity without selecting Ea.
robustness: All three holds and both gap policies; quantify prediction deltas versus immutable B0 and primary EA40, no averaging of assumptions or confidence intervals.
schema: Each candidate export id,segment_id,thickness_pred; exactly 525+1475 rows; additional provenance and quality flags in prediction_diagnostics.csv
preservation: All new artifacts only in experiments/temperature_v02_04; no edits to source, existing tests, prior stages, original data, processed artifacts, config, or official predictions. No push or promotion.
